name: Agent Budget Authorization Limits
description: Defines spending thresholds per AI Employee role. Finance: $100K. Procurement: $100K. All others: $50K. Exceeding limit requires Manager approval.

name: RBAC — AI Employee Data Access Tiers
description: Four-tier data access framework: Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted. AI Employees inherit role-based access. Cross-BU data requires approval.

name: Regulatory Compliance — Financial Decisions
description: All financial decisions exceeding $50K require human CFO sign-off. Automated reconciliation allowed within defined bounds per SOX controls.

name: AI Employee Behavior — No External Communication
description: AI Employees may not communicate with external parties without explicit human approval. All external actions logged and auditable.

name: Data Residency — EU Customer Records
description: EU customer data must remain within EU infrastructure. Revenue Scout and Customer Success AI cannot transfer EU data cross-region.

name: Supplier Contract Approval — >$100K
description: All supplier contracts exceeding $100K require Procurement Manager review and CFO approval. Procurement AI authorized up to $100K autonomously.

name: Human Oversight — High-Risk Workflow Execution
description: Any workflow classified as P1 Critical or affecting >2 Business Units requires human approval before execution.

name: Agent Replacement Trigger — Risk Score >75
description: AI Employees with risk score >75 are flagged for replacement evaluation. Governance board notified within 24 hours. Suspension may be automatic.
